description: Post-op wound infection after right elbow ORIF (Pseudomonas + MRSA), Part D CMM. The reference doc's worked case.
one_liner: Services Requested: Cefepime 2g vial IV q12h (Dose: 2g, Total Qty: 84 vials) + Daptomycin 500mg vial IV q24h (Dose: 335mg, Total Qty: 42 vials) – J0692 x336, J0878 x14070 for T81.49XA + L08.9 Dates of Service: 07/24/2026 to 09/03/2026 (42 day supply).
judgment_notes: SME deliberately routed diagnosis as post-op skin/soft-tissue infection (T81.49XA + L08.9), NOT hardware/internal-fixation infection, to keep the case clean for FDA-supported use under Part D — even though the chart mentions ORIF hardware. Open questions: why .49XA over .42XA; why L08.9 over documented organism codes (B96.5/B95.62). | 2026-10-13: the 99601/99602 entries in forbidden_in_output are KEPT, but they are now justified by this case's submission type (Part D, medication only) rather than by a global ban. The SME narrowed the 2026-08-03 ruling: nursing and per-diem codes belong on medical-benefit authorizations. See case-002, where the ban was wrong and has been removed.
